metadata.title: Mobile Application Trust

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring only explicitly trusted mobile applications may access institutional services and data.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile applications, application stores, enterprise distribution channels, signing authorities, and runtime policy enforcement.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern expressing application‑centric trust and explicit allow‑listing for mobile access.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Mobile Application Trust aligns with least functionality, integrity, and Zero Trust guidance for mobile platforms.

metadata.remarks: Mobile Application Trust defines the conditions under which a mobile application is permitted to participate in institutional workflows. This pattern explicitly rejects device execution trust and enforces application‑centric authorization.

components.title: Authorized Application Origin Control
components.description: Ensures mobile applications originate only from institution‑approved app stores or enterprise distribution channels.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Delivery of malicious mobile applications through untrusted or third‑party distribution channels.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled software distribution prevents installation of untrusted applications.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Restrictions on mobile software installation sources are enforced.
Approved software lists are maintained for mobile platforms.

components.title: Mobile Application Integrity Verification
components.description: Ensures mobile applications are cryptographically signed and validated prior to execution and service access.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Modification of application binaries to introduce malicious behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Code signing validates application publisher identity and integrity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity verification mechanisms detect unauthorized application modification.

components.title: Mobile Application Allow‑Listing
components.description: Restricts access to institutional services and data to explicitly approved mobile applications.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of application permissions to access sensitive data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least functionality is enforced through mobile application allow‑listing.
Mobile access is restricted based on approved applications.

components.title: Mobile Application Risk Evaluation
components.description: Evaluates application behavior, permissions, and risk signals before permitting access to institutional resources.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of excessive or misleading permissions by mobile applications.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Dynamic risk assessment identifies unsafe application behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Ongoing evaluation of application vulnerabilities and risk indicators.
